scope: Static source-assisted computation map; no model or checkpoint load in this task
mode: CPU FP32 reconstructed full-prefill, dropout zero, explicit matmul/softmax; cache equations documented only, historical cache/full fidelity unresolved

conventions.repeatKV: query heads 0,1 use KV head 0; 2,3 use 1; 4,5 use 2; 6,7 use 3
conventions.RoPE: split-half pairs (j,j+48), j=0..47; frequency=1000000^(-2*j/96); rotates normalized q and k only
conventions.padding_mask: add -1e9 for masked keys; query rows are not removed
conventions.matrix_convention: row-vector last-axis linear x W^T, no biases
conventions.tying: Stored groups 0 and 90 are separate; reconstruction uses separate arrays. Upstream source defaults tie_word_embeddings=True. Separate storage does not prove independent training or unequal numerical values.
